rows.declined: Postdoc produced 5 claims, none of which passed validation, so none of them are shown. This is a fault in the answer, not in the corpus — the evidence may well be there.

rows.question: What would PHB cost per kilogram at the titres and yields reported so far?
rows.declined: Cost per kilogram of PHB cannot be established. The corpus has no completed techno-economic run and no verified titre and yield set for one strain and feed, so the requested cost figure has no support.

rows.question: What has nobody measured yet for recycled-paper reject fibre as a PHA feedstock?
